scope: SQM recorded readings and missing/stale presentation
reproduced_before_fix: Empty image database rendered numeric defaults without an explicit missing state; lunar phase was read from image metadata that does not provide it
changes: Missing measurements remain null and render as em dash
Recorded zero values remain visible as zero
Most recent non-future image carries capture timestamp and current/stale state
30-minute summary excludes future timestamps and other cameras
Moon illumination comes from the existing astronomical provider
targeted_tests: 20-minute stale image still represented in 30-minute summary
Astronomical phase independent of image metadata

regression.environment: Isolated Raspberry Flask fixture and local Node tests
